summary: Validated per-line-item fulfillment end-to-end for backend and UI. Existing regression pytest for line fulfillment passed (2/2), and UI automation confirmed each line can be updated independently, sibling line remains unchanged, and aggregate order status auto-transitions only when all lines reach shipped/delivered states.

issues: Console warning repeatedly logs chart container width/height as -1 before layout settles.
One 404 static resource load was observed in browser console during test run (non-blocking for fulfillment flow).

action_items: Optional: investigate recurring chart sizing warning in console for cleaner runtime diagnostics.
Optional: identify the missing 404 static asset seen during UI run.
critical_code_review_comments: Confirmed in backend code that PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/items/{line_id}/fulfillment calls send_customer_order_line_status_update (item-specific) and does not call whole-order status helper in that path.
Order line creation path (_build_order_line) correctly seeds line_id and fulfillment_status='pending'.
OrderLineInput.quantity has no explicit ge=1 validation in Pydantic model; invalid zero/negative quantities could still be posted unless upstream validation blocks them.
seed_data_creation: Created one UI test multi-line order via POST /api/orders during Playwright run (order id: 8045205c-62fd-40c3-8fb8-16ca08ef20c7). No direct DELETE /api/orders endpoint found for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Per-line fulfillment feature appears healthy. If re-running UI flow, login with QA admin, open Orders -> first row, and verify data-testids order-line-item-fulfillment-{i}-{status} plus order-status-auto-badge transitions.
rca of the issue: No feature-breaking issue reproduced. Requested behaviors were validated through pytest + UI automation and aligned with implementation in server.py/helpers.py.
